title: Huliheʻe Palace
axis: Local +X follows the waterfront elevation toward the south-southeast. Local +Z runs out through the two-story lanai toward Kailua Bay.

nativeAxes.z: west-southwest through the lanai toward Kailua Bay

features.role: Named surveyed palace footprint including the bayside roofed gallery and a small side projection.

identityStatus: Named native palace outline, original coastal elevation, National Register measurements, Daughters of Hawaiʻi history and three exact published public-domain Qualla exterior photographs.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged local elevation on the palace grounds immediately in front of the lanai approach.

notes: A stuccoed two-story lava-rubble block with a low green metal gabled roof. A two-deck sea-facing timber lanai has finely spaced balusters, square posts, brackets and a long external stair at the end. Smaller porches mark the street and side entrances.
